title: Your Village
blurb: Beasts settle at your home and take on the boring work, and the home grows round them.

steps.hint: Beasts come to a home that has a use for them. The Hearth tab says what yours is missing.
Each one takes a nook, and your home gets more nooks as it grows.

steps.text: Reach Steading: four rooms, one Fine, a field or pen, and a bell tower.
steps.hint: It needs D-rank. The bell hangs 8 or more above your fire. The upgrade is on the Your Hearth screen.

steps.text: Build an Ore Shed: a lode heart and a barrel in one room.
steps.hint: Hearts beat inside lodes, deep underground; break one free and bring it home.

steps.text: Peg out a Work Plan at home and see what comes to build it.
steps.hint: Or build the room yourself: a Smeltery, a Rookery, a Foundry or a Storehouse all count.

steps.text: Reach Village: six rooms and thirty bells in your song.
steps.hint: Your village is named on the Atlas.

steps.text: Reach the last tier: ten rooms, two of them Grand.
